senses.sense_definition: The practice of promoting fraudulent or unproven medical treatments, typically to make money.

examples.text: The doctor warned his patients against the <w>quackery</w> of miracle cures sold online.
Many people fell victim to <w>quackery</w> because they were desperate for a cure.

senses.sense_definition: A specific act or instance of using fraudulent medical practices.

examples.text: The report exposed several <w>quackeries</w> that had been marketed as breakthrough treatments.
He was eventually arrested for his various <w>quackeries</w> involving fake herbal supplements.
